about_the_game:
As passionate developers, we are committed to delivering top-notch strategy experiences. This support DLC is a way for you to directly back our efforts. While it doesn't add additional in-game content, it includes:

  • Six stunning 4K wallpapers featuring the main art from all Imperiums scenarios.
  • Unique intro background music created especially for Imperiums.
  • Main Menu Decoration: A unique addition to your main menu as a reminder of your generous contribution.

Every purchase helps us continue enhancing and refining our games with updates, bug fixes, and improvements based on community feedback.

Your support also enables us to dedicate resources to exciting new ventures. We’re working on a brand-new DLC while laying the foundation for an entirely new strategic game that we’re excited to share with you in the future.

If you’d like to support us further, you can buy us a coffee directly through our website or join us on Patreon for ongoing contributions. Patreon members gain exclusive behind-the-scenes updates as we shape the future of strategy gaming.

By purchasing this DLC, you're not just supporting us as developers—you’re investing in the future of immersive and innovative strategy games. If you’ve enjoyed our work and want to see what’s next, this is your chance to join us on the journey.

Thank you for being part of our community and helping us keep the spirit of strategy gaming alive!
